title: Moroccan Pecan Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan-inspired sweet tagine made with toasted pecans and fragrant spices. This dessert is perfect for warm weather and can be served as a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the toasted pecans, almonds, honey, coconut oil, maple syrup, cinnamon, ginger, and salt until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x5-inch loaf pan or a small tagine dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until fragrant and lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely before serving.
